title: A Man Rode a Rocket Sled at 632 mph and Stopped in 1.4 Seconds

scenes.text: A man rode a rocket sled at 632 miles an hour.
Air Force Colonel John Stapp did it in 1954, to test what a human body could survive.
Then the sled stopped. In just one point four seconds.
That's 46 times the force of gravity, about like hitting a brick wall at 50 miles an hour.
A normal person would not survive that. Stapp did.
Six hundred thirty-two miles an hour to zero. Now watch it again.

description:
In 1954, Air Force Colonel John Stapp rode a rocket sled at 632 miles an hour and was stopped in 1.4 seconds.
The braking force peaked at 46.2 times gravity.
Would you have strapped in?
first_comment: Would you have strapped into that sled? Be honest.
